title: Aksjeloven § 6-29 (styreprotokoll) and § 5-16 (protokoll fra generalforsamling)
source: Lov om aksjeselskaper (aksjeloven), LOV-1997-06-13-44; § 6-29 as amended by lov 16. juni 2017 nr. 71, § 5-16 as amended by lov 28. mai 2021 nr. 51. Read on lovdata.no 2026-10-09.

rules.text: Board minutes give at least the time and place, the participants, how the board dealt with the matter (Behandlingsmåte) and its decisions.
When a decision is not unanimous, the minutes say who voted for and who voted against.
Every board member who took part signs; a board of five or more that met may instead pick two members to sign.
A board member or the general manager who disagrees may have their view recorded in the minutes.
General meeting minutes give the time and form of the meeting and each decision with the result of the vote; the list of shareholders present is put in or attached.
The chair and at least one other person the general meeting picks among those present sign the minutes.
Board and general meeting minutes are kept safely for the company's life.
